ctaHeading: Mickleham's Pressure Cleaning Pros Are Ready
aboutText: Pressure Now has been serving Mickleham and the greater Melbourne area with top-quality exterior cleaning for years. Specialising in pressure washing, soft washing, and concrete restoration, we transform tired-looking properties back to their best. Our attention to detail ensures every client is thoroughly satisfied with the results, making us Mickleham's go-to choice for all exterior cleaning needs.
servicesText: At Pressure Now, we offer a comprehensive range of pressure washing services tailored to your needs. From driveway cleaning to full property soft washes, our team uses the latest equipment and techniques to deliver spotless results across Mickleham and beyond.

services.title: Pressure Washing Driveways
services.desc: We use high-pressure water to remove dirt, grime, and stains from your driveway, restoring its original appearance and boosting curb appeal.

services.title: Soft Washing for Exteriors
services.desc: Our gentle soft washing method safely cleans delicate surfaces like walls and roofs, eliminating mould and dirt without causing damage.

services.title: Concrete Cleaning & Restoration
services.desc: We specialise in bringing old concrete back to life by removing stains and discolouration, leaving it looking fresh and new.

services.title: Gutter & Roof Cleaning
services.desc: Our team clears gutters and roofs of debris and buildup to prevent blockages and maintain the integrity of your property.

services.title: Fence & Deck Washing
services.desc: We thoroughly clean fences and decks, removing algae and weathering to enhance their look and extend their lifespan.

services.title: Commercial Pressure Washing
services.desc: Tailored solutions for businesses, ensuring your commercial property maintains a professional and inviting exterior for customers.
